title: What the other option earns
hook: A toy project looks profitable. What if the same budget has a valuable alternative?

knows: basic arithmetic and the meaning of a percentage
doesNotKnow: Subtract the foregone alternative in every branch when comparing mutually exclusive uses of one budget.

misconception: Positive gross expected revenue makes a project preferable even when another use of the same budget earns more.
objective: Subtract the foregone alternative in every branch when comparing mutually exclusive uses of one budget.
